defaults.SERVERDESCRIPTION: An GSCS 7 Days to Die server

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Whatever you want the name of the server to be.

configurationFields.label: Serverbeschreibung
configurationFields.description: Whatever you want the server description to be, will be shown in the server browser.
configurationFields.default: An GSCS 7 Days to Die server

configurationFields.label: Server Website URL
configurationFields.description: Website URL for the server, will be shown in the serverbrowser as a clickable link.

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Password to gain entry to the server.

configurationFields.label: Server Login Confirmation Text
configurationFields.description: If set the user will see the message during joining the server and has to confirm it before continuing.

configurationFields.label: Region
configurationFields.description: The region this server is in.

configurationFields.label: Language
configurationFields.description: Primary language for players on this server. Should be the English name of the language, e.g. not "Deutsch" but "German"

configurationFields.label: Server Port
configurationFields.description: Whatever you want the name of the server to be.

configurationFields.label: Server Visibility
configurationFields.description: As you are never a friend of a dedicated server, setting this to "Only shown to friends" will only work when the first player connects manually by IP.

configurationFields.label: Server Disabled Network Protocols
configurationFields.description: Dedicated servers should disable SteamNetworking if there is no NAT router in between your users and the server or when port-forwarding is set up correctly.

configurationFields.label: Server Max World Transfer Speed
configurationFields.description: Maximum speed in kiB/s the world is transferred at to a client on first connect if it does not have the world yet. Maximum is about 1300 kiB/s, even if you set a higher value.

configurationFields.label: Server Max Player Count
configurationFields.description: Maximum Concurrent Players.

configurationFields.label: Server Reserved Slots
configurationFields.description: Out of the Server Max Player Count this many slots can only be used by players with a specific permission level.

configurationFields.label: Server Reserved Slots Permission
configurationFields.description: Required permission level to use the reserved slots above.

configurationFields.label: Server Admin Slots
configurationFields.description: This many admins can still join even if the server has reached Server Max Player Count. Only applies to server versions Alpha 20.7 and above.

configurationFields.label: Server Admin Slots Permission
configurationFields.description: Required permission level to use the admin slots above. Only applies to server versions Alpha 20.7 and above.

configurationFields.label: Persistent Player Profiles
configurationFields.description: Enable/Disable players joining with the same profile they last logged in with.

configurationFields.label: Control Panel / Web Dashboard Enabled
configurationFields.description: Enable/Disable the web control panel / web dashboard.

configurationFields.label: Control Panel / Web Dashboard Port
configurationFields.description: Port of the control panel / web dashboard webpage.

configurationFields.label: Control Panel Password
configurationFields.description: Password to gain entry to the control panel. This only applies to game version 20.7 and below.

configurationFields.label: Web Dashboard URL
configurationFields.description: External URL to the web dashboard if not just using the public IP of the server, e.g. if the web dashboard is behind a reverse proxy. Needs to be the full URL, like "https://domainOfReverseProxy.tld:1234/". Can be left empty if directly using the public IP and dashboard port. Only applies to server versions Alpha 21.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Web Dashboard Map Rendering Enabled
configurationFields.description: Enable/disable rendering of the map to tile images while exploring it. This is used e.g. by the web dashboard to display a view of the map.

configurationFields.label: Telnet Password
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the password to the server's telnet interface (RCON).

configurationFields.label: Telnet Failed Login Limit
configurationFields.description: After this many wrong passwords from a single remote client the client will be blocked from connecting to the Telnet interface.

configurationFields.label: Telnet Failed Logins Block Time
configurationFields.description: How long will the block persist.

configurationFields.label: Admin File Name
configurationFields.description: Server admin file name. Path relative to User/Saves.

configurationFields.label: Crossplay Enabled
configurationFields.description: Enables/Disables crossplay. Server Max Player Count must be no more than 8, EAC must be enabled, and Ignore EOS Sanctions must be disabled. See [crossplay requirements](https://7daystodie.com/crossplay-server-requirements/). Only applies to server versions 2.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: EAC Enabled
configurationFields.description: Enables/Disables EasyAntiCheat. Selecting an overhaul mod under "Mod Mode" in the Updates section disables EasyAntiCheat automatically and overrides this setting, because overhaul mods load their own code and players would otherwise be kicked when they connect. Note that disabling EasyAntiCheat also prevents console players from joining, so a server cannot run an overhaul mod and support crossplay at the same time.

configurationFields.label: Hide Command Execution Log
configurationFields.description: Hide logging of command execution..

options.2: Also hide from remote game clients

configurationFields.label: Max Uncovered Map Chunks Per Player
configurationFields.description: Override how many chunks can be uncovered on the ingame map by each player. Resulting max map file size limit per player is (x * 512 Bytes), uncovered area is (x * 256 m²). Default 131072 means max 32 km² can be uncovered at any time.

configurationFields.label: Max Chunk Age
configurationFields.description: The number of in-game days which must pass since visiting a chunk before it will reset to its original state if not revisited or protected (e.g. by a land claim or bedroll being in close proximity).

configurationFields.label: Save Data Limit
configurationFields.description: The maximum disk space allowance for each saved game in megabytes (MB). Saved chunks may be forceably reset to their original states to free up space when this limit is reached. Negative values disable the limit.

configurationFields.label: Ignore EOS Sanctions
configurationFields.description: Ignore EOS sanctions when allowing players to join. Only applies to server versions 1.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Game World
configurationFields.description: "RWG" (see WorldGenSeed and WorldGenSize options below) or any already existing world name in the 'Data/Worlds' or 'User/GeneratedWorlds' folders.

configurationFields.label: World Gen Seed
configurationFields.description: If RWG this is the seed for the generation of the new world. If a world with the resulting name already exists it will simply load it.

configurationFields.label: World Gen Size
configurationFields.description: If RWG, this controls the width and height of the created world. Officially supported sizes are between 6144 and 10240 and must be a multiple of 2048, e.g. 6144, 8192, 10240.

configurationFields.label: Game Name
configurationFields.description: Whatever you want the game name to be (letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, dashes and periods only). This affects the save game name as well as the seed used when placing decoration (trees etc) in the world. It does not control the generic layout of the world if creating an RWG world.

configurationFields.label: Spielmodus
configurationFields.description: Only one game mode available at this time. Placeholder for future options.

configurationFields.label: Sandbox Code
configurationFields.description: Sets the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for configuring various sandbox gameplay options. Default = Adventurer difficulty. Generate a code by using this unofficial [online generator](https://hosthavoc.com/tools/7-days-to-die/sandbox-code-generator), or by clicking the sandbox options button on the new game screen in-game and adjusting the options. Only applies to server versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Game Difficulty
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level of the game. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Player Block Damage
configurationFields.description: How much damage do players to blocks (percentage in whole numbers). Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: AI Block Damage
configurationFields.description: How much damage do AIs do to blocks (percentage in whole numbers). Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: AI Block Damage Blood Moon
configurationFields.description: How much damage do AIs do during blood moons to blocks (percentage in whole numbers). Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: XP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: XP gain multiplier (percentage in whole numbers). Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Player Safe Zone Level
configurationFields.description: If a player is less or equal this level he will create a safe zone (no enemies).

configurationFields.label: Player Safe Zone Hours
configurationFields.description: Hours in world time this safe zone exists.

configurationFields.label: Build Create
configurationFields.description: cheat mode on/off.

configurationFields.label: Day Night Length
configurationFields.description: Real time minutes per in game day: 60 minutes. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Day Light Length
configurationFields.description: In game hours the sun shines per day: 18 hours day light per in game day. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Biome Progression
configurationFields.description: Enable/disable biome hazards. Weather and storms are not affected by this setting. Only applies to server versions 2.0 to below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Storm Frequency
configurationFields.description: Adjusts the frequency of storms. 0 turns them off. Vanilla values: 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400, 500. Only applies to server versions 2.0 to below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Death Penalty
configurationFields.description: Penalty after dying. This setting has different meeanings between the base game and Undead Legacy modded servers. Base game - Nothing: no penalty. Default: classic XP penalty. Injured: you keep most of your debuffs, food and water are set to 50% on respawn. Permanent Death: your character is completely reset and respawns fresh within the saved game. Undead Legacy - Nothing: no XP debt and no attribute-lowering debuff. Beginner: near death trauma debuff, closest to the base game experience. Moderate: as Beginner, plus loss of random action skills. Standard: as Moderate, plus you respawn with partial health, food and water.

options.1: Default: Classic XP Penalty / UL Beginner

configurationFields.label: Drop On Death
configurationFields.description: What a player drops upon death. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Drop On Quit
configurationFields.description: What a player drops when quitting. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Bedroll Dead Zone Size
configurationFields.description: Size (box "radius", so a box with 2 times the given value for each side's length) of bedroll deadzone, no zombies will spawn inside this area, and any cleared sleeper volumes that touch a bedroll deadzone will not spawn after they've been cleared.

configurationFields.label: Bedroll Expiry Time
configurationFields.description: Number of real world days a bedroll stays active after owner was last online.

configurationFields.label: Allow Spawn Near Friend
configurationFields.description: Whether new players joining the server for the first time can select to join near any friend playing at the same time. Only applies to server versions 2.0 and above.

options.2: Only near friends in forest biome (default)

configurationFields.label: Allow Spawn Near Backpack
configurationFields.description: Allow players to respawn near their last dropped backpack when they die. Only applies to server versions Alpha 21.0 to Alpha 21.1.

configurationFields.label: Camera Restriction Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether and how camera views are restricted for players. Only applies to server versions 2.5 and above.

options.0: Can freely swap between first and third person views

configurationFields.label: Jar Refund Percentage
configurationFields.description: The empty jar refund percentage after consuming an item. Only applies to server versions 2.5 to below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Max Spawned Zombies
configurationFields.description: This count covers the entire world. It is scaled based on use case (x1.9 blood moons, x2.1 sleepers). Changing this setting can have a huge impact on performance.

configurationFields.label: Max Spawned Animals
configurationFields.description: If your server has a large number of players you can increase this limit to add more wildlife. Animals don't consume as much CPU as zombies. NOTE: That this doesn't cause more animals to spawn arbitrarily: The biome spawning system only spawns a certain number of animals in a given area, but if you have lots of players that are all spread out then you may be hitting the limit and can increase it.

configurationFields.label: Server Max Allowed View Distance
configurationFields.description: Max viewdistance a client may request (6 - 12). High impact on memory usage and performance.

configurationFields.label: Max Queued Mesh Layers
configurationFields.description: Maximum amount of Chunk mesh layers that can be enqueued during mesh generation. Reducing this will improve memory usage but may increase Chunk generation time.

configurationFields.label: Enemy Spawn Mode
configurationFields.description: Enable/Disable enemy spawning. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Enemy Difficulty
configurationFields.description: Difficulty of the enemies. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Zombie Feral Sense
configurationFields.description: When zombies should have feral sense. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Zombie Move Day
configurationFields.description: Zombie movement speed during the day. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Zombie Move Night
configurationFields.description: Zombie movement speed during the night. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Zombie Feral Move
configurationFields.description: Zombie movement speed of feral zombies. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Zombie Move Blood Moon
configurationFields.description: Zombie movement speed during a blood moon. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Zombie Smell Movement Speed
configurationFields.description: Zombie movement speed after detecting a smell. Only applies to server versions 2.5 to below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Blood Moon Frequency
configurationFields.description: What frequency (in days) should a blood moon take place. Set to "0" for no blood moons. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Blood Moon Range
configurationFields.description: How many days can the actual blood moon day randomly deviate from the above setting. Setting this to 0 makes blood moons happen exactly each Nth day as specified in Blood Moon Frequency. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Blood Moon Warning
configurationFields.description: The Hour number that the red day number begins on a blood moon day. Setting this to -1 makes the red never show. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Blood Moon Enemy Count
configurationFields.description: This is the number of zombies that can be alive (spawned at the same time) at any time PER PLAYER during a blood moon horde, however, MaxSpawnedZombies overrides this number in multiplayer games. Also note that your game stage sets the max number of zombies PER PARTY. Low game stage values can result in lower number of zombies than the BloodMoonEnemyCount setting. Changing this setting has a huge impact on performance. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Loot Abundance
configurationFields.description: Percentage of loot in whole numbers. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Loot Respawn Days
configurationFields.description: Days in whole numbers for loot to respawn. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Air Drop Frequency
configurationFields.description: How often airdrop occur in game-hours, 0 = never. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Air Drop Marker
configurationFields.description: Sets if a marker is added to map/compass for air drops. Only applies to server versions below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Party Shared Kill Range
configurationFields.description: The distance you must be within to receive party shared kill xp and quest party kill objective credit.

configurationFields.label: Player Killing Mode
configurationFields.description: Player Killing Settings.

configurationFields.label: Land Claim Count
configurationFields.description: Maximum allowed land claims per player.

configurationFields.label: Land Claim Size
configurationFields.description: Size in blocks that is protected by a keystone.

configurationFields.label: Land Claim Dead Zone
configurationFields.description: Keystones must be this many blocks apart (unless you are friends with the other player).

configurationFields.label: Land Claim Expiry Time
configurationFields.description: The number of real world days a player can be offline before their claims expire and are no longer protected.

configurationFields.label: Land Claim Decay Mode
configurationFields.description: Controls how offline players land claims decay.

options.2: None (Full protection until claim is expired)

configurationFields.label: Land Claim Online Durability Modifier
configurationFields.description: How much protected claim area block hardness is increased when a player is online. 0 means infinite (no damage will ever be taken). Default is 4x.

configurationFields.label: Land Claim Offline Durability Modifier
configurationFields.description: How much protected claim area block hardness is increased when a player is offline. 0 means infinite (no damage will ever be taken). Default is 4x.

configurationFields.label: Land Claim Offline Delay
configurationFields.description: The number of minutes after a player logs out that the land claim area hardness transitions from online to offline. Default is 0.

configurationFields.label: Dynamic Mesh Enabled
configurationFields.description: Is Dynamic Mesh system enabled?

configurationFields.label: Dynamic Mesh Land Claim Only
configurationFields.description: Is Dynamic Mesh system only active in player LCB areas?

configurationFields.label: Dynamic Mesh Land Claim Buffer
configurationFields.description: Dynamic Mesh LCB chunk radius.

configurationFields.label: Dynamic Mesh Max Item Cache
configurationFields.description: How many items can be processed concurrently, higher values use more RAM.

configurationFields.label: Twitch Server Permission Level
configurationFields.description: Required permission level to use twitch integration on the server.

configurationFields.label: Twitch Blood Moon Allowed
configurationFields.description: If the server allows twitch actions during a blood moon. This could cause server lag with extra zombies being spawned during blood moon.

configurationFields.label: Quest Progression Daily Limit
configurationFields.description: Limits the number of quests that contribute to quest tier progression a player can complete each day. Quests after the limit can still be completed for rewards. -1 = infinite. Only applies to server versions 1.0 to below 3.0 - use the [Sandbox Code](https://7daystodie.com/v3-0-dead-hot-summer-release-notes/) for versions 3.0 and above.

configurationFields.label: Release Stream
configurationFields.description: Sets the server release stream to install. The "Public" branch has the latest stable version of the server. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Release Stream must also be specified. Update the server after changing this setting.

configurationFields.label: Custom Release Stream
configurationFields.description: Sets a [custom release stream](https://steamdb.info/app/294420/depots/) to use for the Release Stream, if "Custom" is selected. Useful for any release streams not yet included in the Release Stream list

configurationFields.label: Mod Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to install and run the standard server, or a relevant overhaul mod. You must also set the Release Stream accordingly. EAC is automatically disabled when running an overhaul mod (overriding GSCS's setting). Set the Game World to "RWG" or a custom Darkness Falls map when running Darkness Falls. Update the server after changing this setting.

configurationFields.label: Install uMod
configurationFields.description: Auto-installs uMod when the server is updated.

configurationFields.label: Please Read!
configurationFields.description: To install Undead Legacy, select the Stable or Experimental option under "Mod Mode" in the Updates section, set the "Release Stream" to the game version that build targets, then update the server. As of the mod author's current downloads, Stable (UL 2.6.17) targets game Alpha 20.7 b1, so set the Release Stream to "alpha20.7"; Experimental (UL 2.7.26) targets game v2.6, so set the Release Stream to "v2.6". Selecting the wrong stream will stop the mod loading. Undead Legacy must also be installed by every player who connects, and the settings below only take effect when the mod is running. Settings marked "Experimental builds only" do not exist in the Stable (Alpha 20.7) build and are ignored there.

configurationFields.label: Recipe Filter
configurationFields.description: Controls how recipes are displayed.

options.1: Shows unknown recipes, search limited by workstation
options.2: Shows only known and workstation relevant recipes

configurationFields.label: Basic Survival Challenges
configurationFields.description: Determines if you trigger the tutorial challenges upon first spawning on the server. On the Stable (Alpha 20.7) build this is the older "StarterQuestEnabled" option, which GSCS sets from this same value.

configurationFields.label: Wandering Horde Frequency
configurationFields.description: After how many in-game hours a wandering horde would occur. On top of this value 1 to 4 additional hours may be added depending on spawn conditions. Minimum Value: 1

configurationFields.label: Wandering Horde Frequency Range
configurationFields.description: Additional random hours added to Wandering Horde Frequency to add randomness to hours between spawns. For example, Frequency: 5, Frequency RNG Range: 10, then wandering horde will spawn anywhere between 5 to 15 (5+10) in-game hours + additional hours if special conditions occur (No players alive, etc).

configurationFields.label: Wandering Horde Count
configurationFields.description: Fixed zombie count, that will spawn in a Wandering horde. Minimum Value: 2. Zombies + Zombie RNG Range value must not exceed: 64

configurationFields.label: Wandering Horde Count Range
configurationFields.description: This value determines up to how many additional zombies can spawn for Wandering Horde. For example, Zombies: 5, Zombies RNG Range: 10, then wandering horde will spawn anywhere between 5 to 15 5+10 zombies. Combined value must not exceed: 64

configurationFields.label: POI Tier Loot Scale
configurationFields.description: Multiplier determining how important a POI Tier is when scaling Loot Stage. 0% - Disabled Default, 100% Vanilla Scaling. Acceptable values are integers from 0 to 100

configurationFields.label: Stats Death Penalty
configurationFields.description: Undead Legacy's separate stats death penalty (the mod's "DeathPenalty2" option), applied on top of the Death Penalty setting under Gameplay. Experimental builds only.

options.2: Trauma debuff + lose random Action Skills
options.3: Trauma debuff + lose random Action Skills + respawn with partial Health, Food and Water

configurationFields.label: Zombie Rage Chance
configurationFields.description: Percentage chance for a zombie to rage. Experimental builds only.

configurationFields.label: Heat Map Scouts Enabled
configurationFields.description: Enables screamer/scout zombies spawning from the heat map. Experimental builds only.

configurationFields.label: Zombie Digging Enabled
configurationFields.description: Controls when zombies are allowed to dig. Experimental builds only.

options.1: Can dig only during blood moons

configurationFields.label: Group Damage Boost
configurationFields.description: Damage boost applied to grouped zombies. Experimental builds only.

configurationFields.label: Action Skill XP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Multiplier applied to Action Skill experience gain. 100% is the mod default. Experimental builds only.

configurationFields.label: Trader Mission Cooldown
configurationFields.description: Cooldown before trader missions become available again. Experimental builds only.

configurationFields.label: Dusk Time
configurationFields.description: In-game hour at which dusk begins. Experimental builds only.

configurationFields.label: Dawn Time
configurationFields.description: In-game hour at which dawn begins. Experimental builds only.

configurationFields.label: Ambient Light Level
configurationFields.description: Ambient light level used by the mod at night. Experimental builds only.

configurationFields.label: Override Brightness
configurationFields.description: Forces a fixed brightness level on clients. -1 leaves brightness up to each player. Experimental builds only.
